source: FeedHero XML — Reiss GB Google Shopping output feed (the feed wired in DEFAULT_FEEDS)
note: Primary g:product_type only — the FIRST value on each item; the repeated values after it are the numbered keyword slots, counted separately below and never as category paths. KEYWORD SATURATION USES THE ENGINE’S OWN RULE (labelguard.js kwValueKind): a 24+ character hex id or a spreadsheet placeholder in a keyword slot is NOT a keyword — Reiss and Schuh write a 32-character hex id into slot 2 on nearly every product, so "any slot filled" reads ~100% against the real figure here. "products" counts distinct g:item_group_id; "skus" counts feed rows. This census is deliberately INDEPENDENT of the KWCal seed: the harness checks every seeded path resolves HERE, so a mis-spelled path matches nothing real rather than matching itself.
